title: Certificate: code/recurrence.py

events.description: included events only are considered; excluded ones are ignored

zero_income.description: true when the user has no credit stream and no scheduled income one-off

guarantees: Grouping unit: (direction, category) for groceries/transport/dining; (direction, category, description) otherwise.
Stream iff >=3 occurrences and median consecutive gap in [5, 35]; cadence_days = round(median gap); amount = median; anchor = latest occurrence.
stream_id is deterministic: stream_<user_id>_<n> with n from sorting groups by (direction, category, description or '').
latest_event_id = event_id of the anchor occurrence.
Every included event is in exactly one stream's occurrences or exactly one OneOff — never both, never neither.
No income is synthesised: zero credit streams + zero scheduled credits => zero forecast income.
